recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Future defects involving a specific SearchParameter with a missing path or expression should be handled as separate targeted issues rather than reopening this all-null DSTU1 rendering problem.
issue_request: FHIR-5843 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 correction from DAF ballot comment 89 reporting that the Search Parameters table Paths column generated all values as null.
initial_application: The Jira comments recorded 'Already fixed' on 2015-03-11, and no Jira-keyed source commit was found. Nearby history shows commit a5df1925d8c7bc0d03d8d840ad1b79fcca77eacc on 2015-03-10 added/generated search parameter rendering and guarded path output with hasXpath(), which is consistent with fixing null path rendering before the Jira comment.
additional_context: The current source includes the searchparameter registry template and active resource/search-parameter entries. Representative active SearchParameter source has concrete build path and expression values, current search parameter source files contain no literal null path values, and the current CI build searchparameter registry renders Patient.active without null. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current specification source and current rendered registry already avoid the reported all-null Paths display problem, so this commit records the audit decision only.
